title: Hjalmar Schacht advises Sukarno on a revolutionary fund

tellings.quote: He had met Sucarno. He had been denosified, shocked, and had wound up in Indonesia visiting Sukarno saying you have to build an Islamic crescent to defend against Chinese communism, right?

plain: Hjalmar Schacht, a banker who had served as Nazi Germany's economics minister, went to Indonesia after being cleared in Germany's postwar purge of Nazis and met its leader Sukarno. There, the researcher Peter Levenda says, Schacht told Sukarno he had to build an "Islamic crescent" to hold back Chinese communism. Levenda tells it, without naming a source, as an example of former Nazi figures shaping world politics after the war.
